narrative.northStar: Three exploratory worlds, one habit-to-Ship loop
narrative.overview:
After the interactive comparison, the human selected After hours for prototype refinement, retaining its dark palette and adopting Assembly's top navigation. The detailed Ship mosaic is now a 100-cell spacecraft silhouette with nose, wings and twin engines. The other candidates and original comparison remain available at commit 2073fa1.

The authority stops at this disposable prototype. Production DESIGN.md remains unchanged; final cross-frontend validation and production implementation are not approved.
keyCharacteristics: Three unselected, provisional alternatives at equal interaction fidelity.
Immediate Daily completion; confirmed Ship facts and explicit delayed updates.
Code-authored geometry and licensed self-hosted type, not generated imagery.

rules.name: The Alternative Boundary Rule
rules.body: Keep each provisional palette with its own shell; do not promote or blend it into production identity.

rules.name: The Reserved Comparison Lane Rule
rules.body: Comparison controls occupy a separate bottom lane (124px closed; `min(52dvh, 420px)` open). The app's height is the remaining dynamic viewport and it scrolls independently above that lane. Do not interpret a base viewport capture as the full independently scrolling journey.

dos: Do retain the alternative-specific palette, typeface, geometry, and shell together while comparing.
Do preserve independent app/lab scrolling, narrow-phone Ship stacking, and the shared notice geometry.
Do label synthetic data and keep confirmed facts distinct from pending rewards or deductions.
donts: Don't treat any alternative, descriptive language, or token here as user-approved production identity.
Don't infer whole-frontend, backend, or WCAG certification from this three-view journey review.
Don't turn screenshot evidence or synthesized sidecar preview ramps into shipping image assets or new palette tokens.
